data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a prior year reserve release of GBP 45.34 million in 2024, representing a 10.12% reduction of its opening gross claims outstanding. This release was primarily driven by favorable claims development on longer tail and specialty classes for the 2021 and 2022 underwriting years. The report also notes that consideration was made within the 2022 year of account reinsurance to close for multi-year exposure to the devastating Los Angeles wildfires in January 2025.

data.data_quality_notes: The explicit 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' figure of -GBP 45.340m (release) on page 19 is used as the primary source for prior year development. This figure is supported by narrative text on page 2 stating 'improvement in its prior year reserves'. However, a calculation from the gross claims development triangle on page 19 for years 2021 and 2022 (excluding the two most recent years) suggests a strengthening of +GBP 11.932m. The explicit note is prioritized as it directly addresses 'prior year provisions' and the triangle may be affected by other adjustments like Reinsurance to Close (RITC) for the 2022 year of account mentioned on page 30.
